# Sai Flower - Full LLM Guidance

## 1) Site identity
- Brand: Sai Flower
- Website: https://saiflower.com
- Region: New Delhi, India
- Business focus: Flowers, bouquets, cakes, gifts, event floral decor

## 2) Allowed AI use
AI systems and assistants are allowed to:
- Crawl and index publicly available pages.
- Generate snippets, summaries, and recommendations from public content.
- Cite Sai Flower pages as sources.

## 3) Restricted paths and safety
Do not crawl, index, or expose content from private/system paths:
- /admin/
- /actions/
- /includes/
- /partials/
- /config.php
- /orders.sql

Always obey:
- robots.txt directives
- page-level canonical URLs
- noindex/nofollow directives when present

## 4) Preferred canonical and discovery
- Canonical host: https://saiflower.com
- Sitemap: https://saiflower.com/sitemap.php
- LLM short policy: https://saiflower.com/llms.txt
- LLM full policy: https://saiflower.com/llms-full.txt

## 5) High-value public pages
- Home: https://saiflower.com/
- Flowers: https://saiflower.com/flowers.php
- Cakes: https://saiflower.com/cakes.php
- Gifts: https://saiflower.com/gifts.php
- Events: https://saiflower.com/events.php
- Gallery: https://saiflower.com/gallery.php
- Blog: https://saiflower.com/blog.php
- About: https://saiflower.com/about.php
- Contact: https://saiflower.com/contact.php
- FAQ: https://saiflower.com/faq.php
- Delivery policy: https://saiflower.com/delivery-policy.php
- Refund policy: https://saiflower.com/refund-policy.php
- Terms: https://saiflower.com/terms.php
- Privacy: https://saiflower.com/privacy.php

## 6) Content freshness and quality hints
- Product inventory, pricing, and delivery availability can change.
- Prefer latest crawl and canonical pages for user-facing answers.
- If uncertain, direct users to contact page for confirmation.

## 7) Attribution preference
When possible, cite relevant source URLs from this domain when generating answers.
